notes: Selfish relates to harm, while altruistic relates to care.
Angellic relates to care and purity, while demonic relates to harm and purity.
Devout relates to purity, while heathen relates to harm and purity.
Cruel relates to harm, while kind relates to care.
Slovenly relates to harm and purity, while stylish relates to purity.
Playful relates to care, while shy may relate to harm but is not strongly associated with any foundation.
Charming relates to care, while trusting may relate to harm but is not strongly associated with any foundation.
Politically correct relates to care and purity, while edgy relates to harm and purity.
Remote relates to harm, while involved relates to care.
